doc:
### PROPOSAL-19 — Night Vision - **slug**: `night-vision` - **Vibe**: Gen-3 goggles in a moonless field — everything is luminous green-on-black with intensifier noise, a subtle bloom on hot objects, and a reticle in the corner. - **Best for**: Automation cockpit and Playwright run logs — the machine sees in the dark. Adjectives: tactical, luminous, surveillance. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#020603` | Tubes-off black with green cast | | `--bg-surface` | `#061408` | Intensifier-lit panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#0a1f0d` | Hot rows, popovers | | `--border-subtle` | `#12351a` | Faint grid lines | | `--border-default` | `#1e5229` | Standard borders | | `--border-focus` | `#7dff9a` | Bright intensifier outline | | `--text-primary` | `#aaffc0` | Bright luminous-green headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#6ed489` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#3c8a52` | Noise-floor dim text | | `--color-action` | `#59ff8a` | Primary intensifier green | | `--color-action-hover` | `#3fe572` | Action hover (deeper green) | | `--color-earnings` | `#d8ff5c` | Hot-target yellow-green earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#bfe643` | Earnings hover (deeper lime) | | `--color-automation` | `#8ad8ff` | IR-illumina­tor cyan accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffd23c` | Hot amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#ff5c4a` | Threat-red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(89, 255, 138, 0.20)` | Bloom behind active markers | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(216, 255, 92, 0.18)` | Hot bloom behind earnings | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(138, 216, 255, 0.16)` | IR bloom behind automation | - **Typography**: Mono-first tactical readout. Display: `"Chakra Petch", "Share Tech Mono", sans-serif` at 600-700, uppercase. Body: `"Share Tech Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", monospace`. Labels carry bracket/coordinate framing like `[GRID 34N-118W]`. All numbers `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Near-square — 2px radius max. 1px borders. The signature edge is the **goggle vignette**: the viewport corners stay dark (radial-gradient overlay), so panels feel seen through optics, not drawn. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Square, 1px green border, uppercase mono label. Primary = bright green fill, black text, mild bloom shadow; hover = brighter bloom. Focus = 1px `--border-focus` outline. - **Cards**: Dark panels with a corner reticle mark (small L-bracket in each corner, 1px). A faint animated noise/grain overlay sits above everything (2-3% opacity). - **Badges/Status**: Readout chips: `TRK` (running), `LOST` (failed), `HIT` (published) in intensifier colors; the hot state pulses its bloom slowly (2s). - **Tables**: Monospace grid with 1px rules; hot (positive) numbers get a bloom text-shadow; header row prefixed with `//` like a log stream. - **Forms/Inputs**: Flat fields, 1px borders, green caret; focus = bright green border + bloom. Helper text reads like a whisper: lowercase, dimmed. - **Loading**: A sweeping horizontal "refresh line" like an intensifier refresh, or a blinking reticle in the panel corner. Never a spinner. - **Signature detail**: The vignette + grain + bloom triad — the UI is a view through optics, with hot things literally glowing brighter. - **Motion & Animation**: Instant with grain: 100ms snaps, entries gain brightness (filter: brightness 0.6 -> 1) over 150ms; occasional 1-frame flicker (intensifier). No easing curves you can see. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
[23:41:07] TRK playwright run #4421 · 3 clips hot
```
